info.title: L10 API
info.description: Level 10 meeting app: Scorecard, Rocks, To-Dos, Issues and a live weekly meeting.

get.description: The process is up and serving. Does not touch the database (see `/api/ready`).
Ready to serve traffic: a `SELECT 1` through the app's session factory succeeds within 2 s.

503.description: The database is unreachable or too slow

429.description: Too many sign-in attempts from this address (`rate_limited`); see `Retry-After`

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another sign-in attempt is accepted

get.description: Teams the caller can open: their memberships, or every team for an Admin.
Members, eligible To-Do owners, the caller's permissions, the business clock (`APP_NOW`) and the active meeting, if any.

403.description: Not a member of this team, or the team does not exist (`team_forbidden`)

get.description: Measurables by week for the 13 weeks ending with the current week, oldest first. `cells` align with `weeks`. Status is computed server-side: a closed week without a score is `off_track`, the current week without a score is `pending`.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`)

put.description: Last save wins. Send `value: null` to clear the cell. Send `expected_version` (from the cell) for lost-update protection: a stale version returns 409 `version_conflict` with the current cell in `detail.current`.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

post.description: Creates an Issue titled `{measurable}, week of {Mon D}`, owned by the caller, or returns the existing unsolved one for that cell. Duplicate-free under concurrency (partial unique index + `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`). 201 when created, 200 when it already existed.

200.description: An unsolved Issue for this cell already existed

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

409.description: The cell is not off track (`not_off_track`)

422.description: Not a Monday or outside the 13-week window

get.description: `unsolved` (default) in Issue order: priority 5 down to 1, oldest first within a priority, no priority last. `solved` newest-solved first.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`)

post.description: Owner is the caller; priority is optional.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

patch.description: `priority` 1..5 or null. Send `expected_version` for lost-update protection.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

post.description: A resolution note is required (1-2000 characters).

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

post.summary: Add a To-Do from an Issue
post.description: Creates a To-Do linked to the Issue, due in 7 days (company calendar). The owner must be an Admin or Team Member of the team (or any Admin).

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

422.description: Owner not eligible (`owner_not_eligible`) or invalid body

get.description: Open To-Dos first (due date ascending), then done ones (done time descending). `completion` is the last closed week's rate (null when nothing was due): done by the week's end / due that week, target 90%.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`)

patch.summary: Mark a To-Do done or undo it
patch.description: `done: true` sets `done_at` to now (kept if already done); `false` clears it. Idempotent.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

post.description: Bonus. Creates an Issue titled `{to-do} (To-Do overdue)` or returns the existing unsolved one for this To-Do. 201 when created, 200 when it already existed.

200.description: An unsolved Issue for this To-Do already existed

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

get.description: Rocks of the current calendar quarter with computed status and progress, and their Milestones. Status: complete if seeded complete; off track if seeded off track or an unfinished Milestone is past due (a Milestone due today is not past due).

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`)

post.description: Bonus. Creates an Issue titled `{rock} (Rock off track)` or returns the existing unsolved one for this Rock. 201 when created, 200 when it already existed.

200.description: An unsolved Issue for this Rock already existed

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

404.description: Unknown Rock in this team's current quarter (`rock_not_found`)

409.description: The Rock is not off track (`not_off_track`)

get.description: The active meeting first, then ended meetings newest first. Filter with `status`.

403.description: No access to the meeting's team (`team_forbidden`)

post.description: The caller becomes the facilitator and is auto-joined. Starts in the Scorecard section reviewing the last closed week. One active meeting per team, enforced by a partial unique index.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

409.description: The team already has an active meeting (`meeting_already_active`, `detail.meeting_id`)

get.description: Full meeting state. `server_now` is the clock time at serialization: the client derives its offset and renders `elapsed = (now + offset) - section_started_at`.

403.description: No access to the meeting's team (`team_forbidden`)

post.description: Idempotent. Anyone who can read the team may join, Observers included.

403.description: No access to the meeting's team (`team_forbidden`)

post.description: Facilitator only. scorecard -> ids -> conclude. A section that overruns never advances by itself.

403.description: Only the facilitator may do this (`not_facilitator`), or no access to the team

409.description: Already in Conclude (`no_next_section`), ended (`meeting_ended`), or the meeting already left `from_section` (`stale_section`)

post.description: Facilitator only, from any section. Writes `ended_at` and the frozen summary snapshot in one transaction.

403.description: Only the facilitator may do this (`not_facilitator`), or no access to the team

put.description: Upsert the caller's 1-10 rating; changeable until the meeting ends. Only in the Conclude section, and only for attendees who are Admins or Team Members.

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`) or an Observer (`read_only_role`)

get.description: Issues solved and To-Dos created during the meeting window `[started_at, ended_at or now]`, as full objects. Used by the Conclude section.

403.description: No access to the meeting's team (`team_forbidden`)

get.description: The snapshot written when the meeting ended: Measurable statuses for the reviewed week, Issues solved, To-Dos created, attendees and rating. Never recomputed, so later edits do not change it.

403.description: No access to the meeting's team (`team_forbidden`)

get.description: Who changed what and when: score edits, issues (created, prioritized, solved), To-Dos (created, done, reopened) and meeting steps (started, advanced, rated, ended). Newest first, keyset paginated: pass `next_before_id` of one page as `before_id` to get the next older page. Changes that did not alter anything (an idempotent done toggle, Make it an Issue returning an existing Issue) and refused requests are not recorded. Events are never updated or deleted.

parameters.name: before_id

schema.description: Only events with an id below this one (the previous page's cursor)
schema.title: Before Id

parameters.description: Only events with an id below this one (the previous page's cursor)

403.description: No access to this team (`team_forbidden`)

online.title: Online
online.description: Has an open WebSocket to this team right now

id.title: Id
id.description: Strictly increasing; newest events have the highest id

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Id of the changed entity; a score is `{measurable_id}:{week_start}` (`m1:2026-11-02`)

at.title: At
at.description: Business time (the injected clock) of the change

data.title: Data
data.description: Action-specific details. score.set/score.cleared: measurable_id, measurable_name, week_start, old, new (null when cleared). issue.created: title, source {type: manual|measurable|rock|todo, ...}. issue.priority_changed: title, old, new. issue.solved: title, resolution_note. todo.created: title, source_issue_id, owner_id, due_date. todo.done/todo.reopened: title. meeting.advanced: from, to. meeting.rated: rating. meeting.started/meeting.ended: empty.

AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent
AuditEvent.description: One business mutation, recorded in the same transaction as the change. Append-only.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as `before_id` to fetch the next (older) page; null when this is the last page

ClockInfo.title: ClockInfo
ClockInfo.description: Business time derived from the injected clock (`APP_NOW`), in company time zone terms.

meeting_id.title: Meeting Id
meeting_id.description: `meeting_already_active`: the id of the meeting that is already running

current_section.title: Current Section
current_section.description: `stale_section`: the section the meeting is actually in

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: The `detail` object of an error response. Which extra keys are present depends on `code`.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: 1..5, or null to clear the priority

anyOf.description: Optimistic lock: the `version` last seen; a stale one gives 409 `version_conflict`.

created.title: Created
created.description: False when an unsolved Issue for the same source already existed

from_section.title: From Section
from_section.description: If set and the meeting is no longer in this section, the call fails with 409 `stale_section` instead of skipping a section (double-click protection).

MeetingAdvance.title: MeetingAdvance
MeetingAdvance.description: Optional body of `POST /meetings/{id}/advance`: the section the facilitator was looking at.

server_now.title: Server Now
server_now.description: Clock time at serialization; elapsed = (now + offset) - section_started_at

MeetingState.title: MeetingState
MeetingState.description: Everything a client needs to render a meeting. Postgres owns it; the WebSocket only notifies.

MeetingSummary.title: MeetingSummary
MeetingSummary.description: Frozen snapshot written when the meeting ends; later edits never change it.

Permissions.title: Permissions
Permissions.description: What the caller may do in this team (UX hint only: the server enforces every rule).

version.title: Version
version.description: Null while the cell has no score

open_issue_id.title: Open Issue Id
open_issue_id.description: The unsolved Issue created from this cell, if any

anyOf.description: Finite number with absolute value below 1e12.
Optimistic lock: the `version` last seen; a stale one gives 409 `version_conflict`.

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: The 13 weeks ending with the current week, oldest first

todos.title: Todos
todos.description: Open first (due date ascending), then done (done_at descending)

completion.description: Null when nothing was due in the last closed week

UserWithTeams.title: UserWithTeams
UserWithTeams.description: `UserRef` plus the user's teams (every team for admins); feeds the login screen's user switcher.
